lastCheckpoint.note: Boundary APPROVED by an independent reviewer (claude-fable-5, differing model) after five adversarial passes. finish PASS is refused because ai-policy-lint recorded FAIL mid-run when TASKS.md crossed its hot-context budget, was fixed by archiving four completed contracts, and re-recorded PASS. Closing BLOCKED rather than arguing with the rule. Second independent encounter today with the same semantics — the expansion-witness rule penalised the same fail-fix-verify loop in TASK-030 — so this is a design question about the ledger, recorded twice, not a one-off.
